momentum.label: Momentum follow
momentum.description: Enter in the direction of a >= $0.10 swing when the post-swing price still leaves >= 2 cents of modelled edge after fees. Holds to settlement.

mean-reversion.label: Mean reversion
mean-reversion.description: Take the opposite side of a swing when the model's shrunk fair value crosses back through 0.50.

value.label: Quiet value
value.description: No swing needed. Buy the side with the largest modelled edge after fees whenever the spread is tight and there is real book depth.

resolution-hold.label: Resolution hold
resolution-hold.description: Buy the side already trading above 0.85 with a tight spread, betting on a clean yes/no resolution. Small payout, frequent wins, occasional total loss.
